description: Find brands that recently gained the most newly-OBSERVED sellers (sellers whose first-seen date on the brand falls in the window) — an observation signal, NOT confirmed market entry (sparse re-sampling can resurface long-present sellers as 'new'). Optional category filter. Use when the user asks 'brands gaining sellers in [category]', 'brands under hijacker pressure', 'who is seeing new entrants this month', or category-scoped seller-growth signals without naming a specific brand.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

max_newly_observed_sellers_in_window.description: Upper bound on new-seller count (min is min_new_sellers).

scope.description: tracked = only brands on the user's watchlist; universe = all brands. Default universe.

name: brands_gaining_sellers
